scope: Completion of the ten bridge/viewmodel performance areas. Benchmarks compare committed first-pass optimized bridge 206c51505 with this working tree. Results are workload-specific; not every individual metric improved.

implementation.change: Revision-aware ABI v5 skips copying and decoding unchanged streams. Existing managed snapshot/wire caches retained. Initial string catalog is retained until its UI delivery succeeds.

Field patches for maps, arrays, nested binary documents and bounded logs implemented and tested, but opt-in because measured CPU cost exceeds full copies. Default is changed-only full snapshots; missed revisions resynchronize.

Compile-time generated lazy display descriptors, direct unboxed primitive writers and four explicit input schemas replace editor serialization/property-display reflection. Uncompressed portable MessagePack retained.

Sidebar 40ms coalescer, bounded owner queues, 40ms strategy publication sampling and 20ms native polling; latest pending native updates retry after queue saturation. Broker acknowledgements/source events retained.
Stable trade workspace/expiry/evidence caches retained; immutable workflow detail/row/graph projections reused when their inputs are unchanged. Generated primitive writes avoid boxing.
Existing bounded single-consumer async gateway owners retained. Worker performs transport/decoding; render thread receives owned snapshots. Startup/reconnection tasks remain off the renderer.
Workflow ingestion lock only captures immutable view references; sorting/presentation occurs outside it. Existing short snapshot and sidebar locks retained.
Bounded encoding pool and owned output arrays retained. Native transport scratch buffer reused. Optional delta trees capped at 131072 nodes and depth64; full fallback on budget exhaustion.
Existing read-outcome limits and mutation deduplication preserved. One full snapshot/optional patch per stream. Latest pending native update retained; sessions drain before disposal.

Workstation/background GC remains default. Workstation and Server benchmarked. Lazy descriptors reduce startup roots; no application forced collections. Bounded optional paint-callback timing implemented and exercised against real Development API.

live.measurement: CPU render-pass callback; excludes GPU completion and display presentation

frames.measurement: native CPU update/layout; excludes GPU presentation and input latency

limitations: Generic field patches are implemented but off by default; bandwidth/allocation savings do not justify their extra in-process CPU cost for the measured workloads.

Short BenchmarkDotNet runs have wide confidence intervals in several timing cases; allocation reductions are stable. Refresh-only scheduling latency did not improve consistently, including the paired workstation probe.

Live quote age includes provider/backend cache age plus the current one-second chain refresh cadence. Native receipt-to-paint is measured separately. This pass does not claim to eliminate upstream age.
Paint timing measures CPU render-command recording, excluding GPU completion and physical screen presentation; profiling adds bounded timestamp scanning/callback overhead.
No new full-solution or full desktop FlaUI sweep was run. Affected managed, shared strategy, Rust widget/contract, embedded-runtime and read-only live API paths were tested.
Fixture-only DispatchProxy remains. Generated serialization is not a claim that the full dependency graph is NativeAOT compatible.
deployment: .artifacts/rust-ui/app contains the final Release bridge and native host; standard VS Code Development launcher unchanged.

followUpContractFix.reason: Market Outlook values/colors and nested chart fields used CLR property names when serialized inside an anonymous dashboard after the optimization pass. Generated wire descriptors now preserve MessagePack Key aliases recursively; plain display document naming is unchanged.
followUpContractFix.benchmarkEvidence: The saved benchmark hashes and timings describe the earlier measured build, before this contract-key correction.
followUpContractFix.deployment: Release bridge rebuilt. Existing running Rust UI must be restarted through the Development launcher to rebuild/load the corrected package.
